item.title: Watch Live: Former mother-in-law says Lindsay Clancy was "begging for help"
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial​ resumed Tuesday in Massachusetts with the 15th day of testimony.

item.title: Trump says no talks with Iran ongoing, and none scheduled
item.description: President Trump says the U.S. is not engaged in any talks with Iran as the two countries remain locked in a standoff over the Strait of Hormuz after almost six months of war.

item.title: Florida voters choose in governor, Senate primaries, and more races to watch
item.description: Three states are holding primaries on Tuesday, with Florida deciding on nominees for both governor and for Senate.

item.title: USS Benfold went days without power in the South China Sea
item.description: The guided-missile destroyer USS Benfold spent four days without power last month after a problem with its engineering, according to a spokesperson for the Navy's 7th Fleet.

item.title: Trump says no Iran talks are planned or ongoing and claims the Strait of Hormuz is open
item.description: President Trump admitted that the U.S. and Iran have no ongoing or planned negotiations right now. Meanwhile, Jared Kushner met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over the fate of Gaza. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: How much interest can a $10,000 9-month CD earn right now?
item.description: A 9-month CD could turn a $10,000 deposit into a worthwhile return, but how much can you earn with one this August?

item.title: Outshine Fruit Bars recalled over possible glass, parent Dreyer's says
item.description: Five flavors of Outshine Fruit Bars sold nationwide were recalled because they may include glass, Dreyer's Grand Ice Cream said.

item.title: Disney and ABC sue FCC over early license review, alleging retaliation
item.description: The lawsuit comes after the FCC ordered ABC to seek renewals between two and five years before its TV stations' licenses were set to expire.

item.title: IRS proposal would force nonprofits to disclose leaders' terrorism convictions
item.description: The disclosure requirement would be added to the Form 990, the annual return that nonprofit groups file with the IRS.

item.title: Family desperately searches for missing woman after getting mysterious texts demanding bitcoin
item.description: A family is desperately searching for a New York woman after she went missing while visiting a friend in Las Vegas. Her daughters say they are now receiving texts from her phone demanding bitcoin. CBS News' Nicole Valdes has more.

item.title: How ultra-processed foods impact our health
item.description: Dr. Dariush Mozaffarian, the director of Food is Medicine Institute at Tufts University, calls ultra-processed foods "the main driver of disease, disability and death in the U.S." He discusses what's considered ultra-processed foods, how they impact our health and how to spot them.

item.title: Nominees revealed for 3 VMA categories
item.description: "CBS Mornings" revealed the nominees for three categories at this year's VMAs, including artist of the year.

item.title: U.S. diplomat calls Israeli strikes on Syria base "unnecessary escalation"
item.description: U.S. Ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack says an Israeli attack on a Syrian air force base was an "unnecessary escalation that does not advance regional stability."

item.title: Construction workers find $10 million gold stash in renovations
item.description: Police issued a warning telling "gold prospectors" to stay away from the construction site

item.title: Florida holds high-stakes primaries with multiple far-left candidates in the mix
item.description: Florida is holding several high-stakes primaries on Tuesday, including gubernatorial races to replace Ron DeSantis. Meanwhile, several democratic socialists are on the ballot. CBS News' Nikole Killion has more.

item.title: Workers discover gold bars, coins worth $10 million while drilling at site of former brewery
item.description: Construction workers in Belgium were drilling into the foundation of a former brewery when they discovered 49 gold bars and more than 4,000 coins worth an estimated $10 million. The gold is in police custody while an investigation is underway.

item.title: Missing woman's family receives texts asking for money, bitcoin
item.description: Alisa Goods, 63, disappeared 10 days ago in Las Vegas. Her family has been receiving mysterious messages from her phone.

item.title: How much can debt forgiveness save on $30,000 in credit card debt this August?
item.description: Having part of a $30,000 credit card balance forgiven could mean big savings, but the final amount can vary widely.

item.title: Some of this year's highly anticipated movies are adaptations from your favorite books
item.description: Amazon Books editorial director Sarah Gelman joins "CBS Mornings" to discuss some of her favorite books coming to the big screen this year.

item.title: Exclusive discounts from CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: On this edition of CBS Mornings Deals, we show you items that will help improve your everyday lifestyle. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: From sleep schedules to vaccinations, here's how to prepare for a healthy school year
item.description: As kids head back to school, pediatrician Dr. Amanda Kravitz shares a health and wellness checklist for every parent - from managing sleep and stress to your child's vaccinations and mental health.

item.title: A grandma of 5 went missing in Vegas. Now her family is getting messages asking for bitcoin.
item.description: There's an urgent search for a New York woman whose family says she disappeared 10 days ago while in Las Vegas. The woman's family hasn't heard from her other than receiving mysterious text messages from her phone asking for payments in cash and bitcoin. Nicole Valdes reports.

item.title: Trial opens 32 years after American woman murdered in Germany
item.description: The man is accused of luring Amy Lopez under false pretenses into a secluded room, where he then allegedly handcuffed her, sexually assaulted her and killed her.

item.title: Activists who posed as Minnesota voters during primary could be in legal trouble
item.description: An undercover video could land a handful of activists in legal trouble. They pretended to be Minnesota voters during the primary.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex-fiancé in "profound shock" after her death
item.description: Hayden Panettiere, who shares a daughter with the former boxing champ, died on Sunday at 36 years old.

item.title: Discord suspends livestreams in Brazil amid backlash over girl's suicide
item.description: Popular American chat app Discord says it suspended livestreams in line with a Brazilian government order, amid fierce criticism over a 13-year-old girl's death.

item.title: U.S., Canada in last-minute talks to head off steep new U.S. tariffs
item.description: Last-minute talks were continuing between the U.S. and Canada in an effort to head off President Trump's plan to impose 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods.

item.title: DOJ asks court to reinstate criminal charges against Abrego Garcia
item.description: In May, a federal judge dismissed a criminal indictment against Abrego Garcia, who had been accused of smuggling immigrants in the U.S. illegally.

item.title: School vaccination rates inch down again to record low
item.description: U.S. kindergarten vaccination rates have declined again, with exemptions reaching a record high for the 2025-2026 school year

item.title: U.S.-Iran ceasefire holds for now, Hegseth says, as Trump looks to finalize deal
item.description: Hegseth said the ceasefire with Iran "certainly holds" for now after a naval clash between Iranian and U.S. forces and renewed attacks on the UAE.
